description: A couple at the end of the line waits a time through and crosses over.

walkthrough.line: This time through you stand out at the end of the line, then cross over.
walkthrough.teach: This time through you stand out at the end of the line. Wait there, then cross to the other line so you come back in on the other side and as the other kind of couple. In a becket set you loop round the end together instead.
